intro: Meet Zenara—a high-back sofa that blends elegant wooden craftsmanship with enveloping comfort. Sink in, unwind, and experience seating that feels refined, restorative, and deeply luxurious.

features.title: Timeless wooden craftsmanship
features.text: Crafted with natural wood, the Zenara Sofa brings a sense of lightness and sophisticated warmth to your interiors, celebrating both traditional craftsmanship and modern minimalism. Thus, your sofa doesn't just sit in your room—it elevates your space.

features.title: Luxurious upholstery
features.text: Experience seating that feels like a gentle embrace. Premium synthetic leather envelops the seat, back, and armrests in cosy luxury. The upholstery of Zenara is known for its durability and comfort, ensuring your sofa feels as inviting after months of use as it does on day one.

features.title: Comfortable high-backrest sofa
features.text: The thoughtfully designed high backrest provides full-body support without overwhelming your space. The tall, enveloping back cradles your shoulders and neck, creating a cocooned seating experience that feels supportive and indulgent.

features.title: Designed for modern, mindful living
features.text: Every detail of Zenara has been carefully considered for how you actually live. The ergonomic armrests narrow gracefully towards the front for a sleek appearance, then widen near the elbow for genuine comfort. The generous ground clearance creates a floating sensation while making everyday floor cleaning effortless.
